blocks.text: 2026 CHALLENGE / CURRICULUM
6 WEEKS. 6 TASKS. 1 INCOME.
The full curriculum for the 2026 Challenge. Every week builds on the last. The task is non-negotiable.
Join the Challenge
6 Weeks
DURATION
6 Included
LIVE SESSIONS
Required
WEEKLY TASK
Week 1: Foundations — Pick Your Business Model
Understand the landscape of online income and choose a model that fits your situation, skills, and timeline.
Task: Write a one-page business brief for your chosen model
Week 2: Market Research — Find a Real Opportunity
Stop guessing. Learn the exact process to find a niche that has real buyers willing to pay.
Task: Validate your niche using the 3-source method
Week 3: Your Offer — Build Something People Actually Want
Learn how to build an offer that sells before you even create it. Positioning, packaging, pricing.
Task: Create your offer one-pager and get 3 pieces of feedback
Week 4: Traffic — Get Your First Visitors
Organic-first traffic strategy. No ad spend required. Learn to use Facebook, YouTube Shorts, and SEO basics.
Task: Post 7 pieces of content in 7 days and report results
Week 5: Conversion — Turn Visitors into Buyers
The difference between traffic and income is your conversion system. Build it this week.
Task: Build your landing page and get your first opt-in
Week 6: Operations — Deliver and Scale
How to fulfil, automate, and build systems so you can grow without burning out.
Task: Document your fulfillment process and identify one thing to automate
JOIN THE 12 MONTH JOURNEY
5,000 BDT. Everything above. 12-month journey.
No subscriptions. No upsells. Pay once and access every class, live session, and task, past and future.
Join the 2026 Challenge
